Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciated the clear performance story. Attached is our updated MAP draft (FastRetail_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf). Two immediate items we want to align on:

1) Load/perf test scheduling: we want Redwood to run a traffic replay of a representative day across our checkout/payment flow. Peak sustained QPS we expect is ~750 QPS for ~10 minutes during promotions with short bursts up to ~1,200 QPS for ~30s.

2) Dedicated capacity sizing: we need a sizing recommendation for a dedicated pool that will safely carry our peak plus 20% headroom. We expect to provision for a production rollout if test results look good.

Can you confirm:
- What format you need for traffic replay (we can provide anonymized ndjson of request logs)
- Proposed test windows in August (we prefer UTC windows overnight ET to minimize customer impact)
- Which Redwood folks will own the test and who on our side needs to be available

Target close: we'd like to be able to finalize the MAP and go-live plan by Sep 3 if Redwood can meet that cadence.

I've attached the MAP draft and a small traffic sample (fastretail_traffic_sample_ndjson.tar.gz). Procurement is looped separately for contract items.

Thanks,
Alex Jennings

- Test windows: suggested windows (UTC): Aug 10 02:00-06:00 UTC or Aug 11 02:00-06:00 UTC (we reserve the right to pick the precise 3-hour ramp/run). Please tell us which you prefer.

- Sizing: initial conservative estimate is ~4 x A100-class GPUs to meet sustained 750 QPS with some batching, but I'll ask Aditya to confirm with the model variant and context length. We may recommend 4–6 GPUs depending on model and quantization.

- Ownership: Rishi (me) will own test coordination, Aditya will run the infra side and sizing, Marissa will drive MAP approvals and procurement lane. On your side we need an engineering lead + procurement contact available during the run window.

I'll update the MAP with these milestones and responsibilities once we lock the test window. Can you confirm the preferred window and provide the sample schema?

Hi all — tagging in for sizing and run plan. Notes from SRE perspective: 

1) Test plan (high level):
- Pre-check: validate ndjson schema & sample (1 business day)
- Dry run: 30–60 minute small-scale replay to validate tooling
- Full run: ramp to target QPS over 10 minutes, hold peak for 10 minutes, include 2x burst profiles for 30s each, ramp down. Expect ~45–90 minutes active test time + 1.5–2 hours for setup/validation = ~3 hours total wall-clock.

2) Inputs needed from FastRetail:
- Model artifact name and tokenizer/version (required to pick kernel paths)
- Context length used in production (max_tokens)
- S3 URL + temporary read creds for replay dataset; current sample file looks good for schema validation.
- A service account or temporary IAM role to push logs back to your S3 bucket if you want post-run artifacts stored there.

3) Sizing recommendation (initial):
- For the model profile you described (medium LLM, 8k context, standard batching): recommend 6 x A100-class GPUs for dedicated pool to hit sustained 750 QPS with 20% headroom and handle bursts safely.
- If you can provide quantized weights (8-bit) and allow optimized kernels, we may be able to validate a 4-GPU configuration in the dry run.

4) Proposed schedule: Aug 11, 02:00-06:00 UTC. We'll plan the dry run 24 hours earlier (Aug 10). Please confirm engineer(s) on your side for the windows above.

I'll prepare a short test run playbook and share by EOD Jul 31.

—Aditya

Alex — thanks, all. Per conversation and internal sizing input, I've updated the MAP with the following milestone entry (attached in MAP draft v3 and updated Drive doc):

Milestone: Load / Performance Test Scheduling
- Objective: Replay representative checkout traffic; validate sustained 750 QPS with 1.2k burst tolerance
- Target run: Aug 11, 2026 (dry run Aug 10) during 02:00-06:00 UTC window
- Redwood responsibilities: Test orchestration (Rishi), infra sizing & execution (Aditya), MAP approvals & procurement coordination (Marissa)
- FastRetail responsibilities: Provide anonymized ndjson traffic sample + schema (Alex), engineering lead on-call during run, provide S3 read access and an IAM role for post-run artifacts
- Dependencies: model artifact + tokenizer details, production context length, S3 credentials, procurement sign-off for dedicated capacity if we recommend >4 GPUs
- Sizing recommendation: initial conservative: 6 x A100-class GPUs (Aditya to confirm post-dry run). If FastRetail can provide quantized weights and allows optimized kernel paths, we will validate 4 x A100 possibility in the dry run.
- Acceptance criteria: sustained 750 QPS for 10 minutes with <=5% tail-latency regression vs baseline, successful end-to-end request/response validation, and a test report delivered within 5 business days of run.
- Target close date for MAP & go-live plan: 2026-09-03

Next steps: Alex — please share the S3 link + sample schema and confirm Aug 11 window. Marissa — can you start procurement + legal loop for the exhibit and expedited review for a dedicated pool if sizing pushes >4 GPUs? Vivek — I'll loop you for post-run CS success criteria and rollout plan.
